cross_runtime_references.name: Goose 2.0: ACP and new TUI
cross_runtime_references.relevance: April 8, 2026: ACP becomes default server mode in Goose 2.0 (not a subcommand). HTTP daemon and WebSocket bridge are opt-in overlays. Relevant to ACP framing in surfaces transport selection. Announcement only: the 2026-09 audit found the shipped release line had not caught up; verify before citing.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code Routines (web-scheduled-tasks)
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Routines as cloud-hosted remote execution: trigger → container start → agent loop → artifacts → result. Lifecycle model for cloud-container remote runtime mode.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code: Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Verified 2026-07-11. Primary source for the shipped Remote Control feature: server mode (`claude remote-control`, --spawn, --capacity), interactive mode (--remote-control/--rc), /remote-control slash command, outbound-HTTPS-only no-inbound-ports network model, short-lived scoped credentials, and explicit contrast table with Claude Code on the web.

cross_runtime_references.name: Claude Code on the web
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Verified 2026-07-11. Cloud-VM session model (claude.ai/code, --cloud flag) distinct from Remote Control; each session gets an isolated VM with the repo cloned. Sibling of Routines on the same cloud-session substrate.

cross_runtime_references.name: openai/codex issue #25552 — app-server-daemon README staleness
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Verified 2026-07-11. Corrects a stale claim about top-level `codex remote-control` bootstrap behavior; clarifies it runs foreground app-server with remote control enabled for one invocation, while daemon lifecycle lives under explicit subcommands.

cross_runtime_references.name: openai/codex discussion #21935 — codex remote-control intended direction
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Verified 2026-07-11. Positions `codex remote-control` as infrastructure for SSH workflows and custom integrations. Which surface owns device pairing changes between releases; check the current CLI help before citing it.

cross_runtime_references.name: OpenAI Codex TUI Snapshot Source
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Pinned first-party source for snapshot-tested terminal UI states: approvals, status lines, hooks, plugins, app-server warnings, goals, and narrow terminals

cross_runtime_references.name: Gemini CLI Repository
cross_runtime_references.relevance: Google's open-source TypeScript coding-agent CLI (Apache 2.0, 105k+ stars). Uses Ink 6 TUI stack. Second major TypeScript coding-agent reference alongside Claude Code.
